simple.meaning: מַקֵּדָה (Maqqêdâh) appears 9 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, beginning at Joshua 10:10. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as death, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַקֵּדָה (H4719) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַקֵּדָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.
These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”
all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.
Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

definitions.full: H4719. Maqqedah מַקֵּדָה proper name, of a location in Judah Josh 15:41 , near Beth Horon 10:10 , and Libnah 10:29 , where was a cave 10:16 ; 10:17 , compare 10:21 , captured by Joshua 10:28 , with a king 10:28 ; 12:16 . ᵐ5 Μακηδα . Site dubious, Warren;Survey Mem.ii. 411 ff., 427 compare El-mughâr , approximately 2 4-Marmiles southwest from Ekron. מִקְדָּשׁ see קדשׁ . מַקְהֵלִים , I, II. מַקְהֵלֹת vide קהל . מִקְוֶא , I, II. מִקְרָה מִקְוֶה, see קוה . מָקוֺם see קוּם . מָקוֺר see קור . [ מִקָּחָה מִקָּח, ] see לקח [ מִקְטָר ], מִקְטֶ֫רֶת see קטר
